race.comment: THE KINGS GOSPEL (5) will be going first up into this and while not always seen at his best doing that, at least is doing it over some ground. Would love it if the surface is soft as it will slow others down. Betting will tell a great tale. SLATE RIPPER (4) did run very well at Kilmore. He came from midfield and rounded them up. He is one who would prefer a better track. This is his right sort of trip. COLOUR CIRCLE (1) has not done much wrong in his recent outings. He has had a trial in the month since the last effort. Will be getting a lovely run in transit. PRESTIGE GEOFFREY (7) has some important gear changes. Should be ready now third up. CLARAPATRA (9) was around the mark in recent outings but a lighter weight will help.
